name: io.github.alinaszaputko-psych/alina-online-booking
title: Alina Szaputko — Online Psychology Consultation Booking
description: Book online psychology consultations with Alina Szaputko; check availability in Polish or Russian.

tools.name: get_professional_profile
tools.description: Read-only. Retrieve Alina Szaputko’s public professional profile, qualifications, services, languages, consultation price, booking rules and policy links. This tool cannot create or change appointments or payments.

tools.name: list_available_slots
tools.description: Read-only. Retrieve current free 60-minute online consultation slots for a date range in Europe/Warsaw. Provide from as a YYYY-MM-DD date and days from 1 to 14 (defaults to 14). Only free slots are returned; no calendar event details or other clients’ information are exposed. This tool cannot reserve a slot, create a booking, or initiate payment.

from.description: First date to check, inclusive, in YYYY-MM-DD format using the Europe/Warsaw time zone.

days.description: Number of consecutive calendar days to check, from 1 to 14. Defaults to 14 when omitted.

tools.name: request_client_consent
tools.description: Sends a confirmation email to the client with the exact proposed online consultation details, booking rules and privacy notice. The client must open the link, review the details and personally confirm consent. This tool does not reserve a slot or initiate payment. Collect no clinical history.

name.description: Client’s full name, as the client wants it recorded for this consultation.

email.description: Client’s email address. The consent confirmation link and booking correspondence are sent to this address.

phone.description: Optional client phone number, including country code if supplied. Omit it if it is not needed.

date.description: Exact proposed appointment date in YYYY-MM-DD format, using the Europe/Warsaw time zone.

time.description: Exact proposed appointment start time in 24-hour HH:MM format, using the Europe/Warsaw time zone.

consultationLanguage.description: Consultation language: pl for Polish or ru for Russian.

interfaceLanguage.description: Optional language for the consent email and confirmation interface: pl for Polish or ru for Russian. Defaults to the consultation language.

tools.name: create_checkout_session
tools.description: Creates a temporary booking hold and Stripe Checkout session; it does NOT confirm an appointment. Invoke only after request_client_consent has sent the client an email, the client has opened the confirmation page, reviewed the exact booking details, rules and privacy notice, and personally confirmed. The client must provide the resulting one-time consentToken. The token is short-lived, bound to the exact booking details and consumed once. Collect no clinical history or reason for therapy. The client enters payment details directly on Stripe; never ask for card data. Reuse the same requestId for retries of the same attempt. Enabled only when the deployment has an explicitly configured Preview test gate or Production live-booking gate. Preview test bookings are marked [TEST]; Production requires explicit live-mode acknowledgement and a Stripe live key. After payment, call get_agent_booking_status and confirm only when paid=true AND confirmed=true.

name.description: Client’s full name, as the client wants it recorded for this consultation.

email.description: Client’s email address. The consent confirmation link and booking correspondence are sent to this address.

phone.description: Optional client phone number, including country code if supplied. Omit it if it is not needed.

date.description: Exact proposed appointment date in YYYY-MM-DD format, using the Europe/Warsaw time zone.

time.description: Exact proposed appointment start time in 24-hour HH:MM format, using the Europe/Warsaw time zone.

consultationLanguage.description: Consultation language: pl for Polish or ru for Russian.

interfaceLanguage.description: Optional language for the consent email and confirmation interface: pl for Polish or ru for Russian. Defaults to the consultation language.

consentToken.description: Short-lived, one-time token supplied by the client after personally confirming the exact appointment details through the emailed consent link. Never invent or reuse a token.

requestId.description: Unique stable identifier for this booking attempt, 16–80 characters using letters, digits, underscore or hyphen.

tools.name: get_agent_booking_status
tools.description: Operational status check. The backend may perform idempotent fulfilment when Stripe confirms payment but webhook delivery is delayed; that can create the appointment Calendar event and send booking notifications. Returns only booking status and appointment date/time, not client contact details, payment credentials, event links or calendar notes. Enabled only when the Preview test gate or Production live-booking gate is explicitly configured. Tell the client the appointment is confirmed only when both paid and confirmed are true.

bookingId.description: Exact booking identifier returned by create_checkout_session. Use it to check payment and appointment confirmation; do not substitute a client name or email.
